items.text: What is the best view you have ever seen from a window or a hilltop?
Walk a lap around the table like a flamingo, one leg raised at each corner.
Have you ever slept outdoors on purpose? How did it go?
Find three leaves or small objects and name each one after a player at the table.
Which season do you enjoy most outdoors, and why?
Lie flat, look up, and describe a cloud shape to the group.
What is the most adventurous place you have ever camped?
Hop on one foot to the nearest door and back.
If you could spend a whole summer on one beach, which beach would it be?
Do ten jumping jacks while the group sings a summer song.
What is the last animal you saw up close?
Pick up any stick and give a twenty-second speech into it as if it were a microphone.
Have you ever got lost on a walk? What happened?
Close your eyes and point at where the nearest voice is coming from, for twenty seconds.
What is the bravest thing you have done outdoors?
Invent a name for the wind and say hello to it, out loud.
Would you rather camp for a week or spend it at a city festival?
Balance a small coin on your palm for ten seconds.
What is the tallest thing you have ever climbed?
Make up a song about the weather and sing the first verse.
What is your go-to picnic food?
Do a slow walking race to the door, with the group as judges.
Have you ever been stung or chased by an animal outside?
Draw a map of this room in the air with one finger and explain it like a tour guide.
What is the most beautiful sky you have ever seen?
Pretend to be a tree in a windstorm for twenty seconds.
What is the longest walk you have ever done in a single day?
Spin slowly three times, then point to where you think north is.
Which outdoor sport would you be worst at, and why?
Count to ten in a language you do not speak, using only your hands.
Have you ever swum in a lake, river or sea at night?
Build a tower of five coins without knocking it over.
What is the weirdest thing you have ever found lying on the ground?
Make up a new national anthem for the group and sing it dramatically.
Would you rather live in the mountains or by the sea?
Pretend to fish from the window and tell the story of the biggest catch.
What is your best memory of a summer evening outdoors?
Walk around the room like you are dragging a heavy suitcase through an airport.
What is the wildest weather you have ever been caught in?
Give a thirty-second travel show intro about the room you are sitting in.
Who here would be best at finding the way out of a forest?
Try to stand up from the floor without using your hands.
What is the best spot you know for watching a sunset?
Describe the smell of summer to the group using only food words.
Have you ever stargazed? What did you see?
Do your best scarecrow impression for twenty seconds.
What is your favourite tree, and why?
Point at a random object across the room and narrate it like a museum guide.
Is rain on a picnic worse than sunburn at the beach?
Make the sound of a thunderstorm and let the group guess what you are imitating.
What is one thing you always forget to pack for a trip?
Walk to the kitchen as if you are wading through hot sand.
Have you ever grown something from a seed? What was it?
Pretend to be a lifeguard and blow an imaginary whistle to start the next round.
What is the furthest from home you have ever been?
Teach the group your best bird call and have everyone copy it.
Would you rather hike a mountain alone or with this group?
Read one sentence from the nearest book in the most dramatic voice you have.
What outdoor activity have you always wanted to try but never did?
Give the group a dramatic heroic salute, then sit back down as if it never happened.
